notes: The many verses predicting the death of the spouse or of children are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy. 'No issue' is softened to 'children are delayed or denied', matching the BPHS rules.

skipped.reason: Need navamsa gender, odd/even navamsa or occupant counts not yet encoded.
Fertility arithmetic from planetary sums and tithis: not encoded.
Past-life curses as the cause of childlessness, and their remedies: not suitable for a report.
Transit and conception-chart timing: not encoded.

rules.text: Jupiter and the 5th lord well placed with a benefic aspect on the 5th, or the ascendant and 5th lords linked (together, in mutual aspect or exchanging signs): children are assured.
rules.note: The text also counts the 5th lord from the Moon; encoded from the ascendant.

rules.text: The 5th house and Jupiter under malefic influence with no benefic help, and the 5th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th: children are delayed or denied.
rules.note: The text also includes the Moon and lords counted from it; encoded from the ascendant.

variants.text: A malefic 5th lord in its own house: children are indicated.
A malefic in the 5th: the text says many children.
A benefic 5th lord in its own house: the text warns of obstacles concerning children.
The 5th house falls in Leo, Virgo or Scorpio, which the text calls 'childless' signs: few children, and only after a long wait.

rules.text: A 'childless' sign on the 5th with the Sun there, Saturn in the 8th and Mars rising — or Saturn rising, Jupiter in the 8th and Mars in the 12th: a child comes late in life and after great effort.

variants.text: The Sun alone in Cancer in the 5th: children possibly by a second partner.
Mars or Venus in Cancer in the 5th: children possibly by a second partner.
Saturn in Cancer in the 5th: many children.
The Moon or Mercury in Cancer in the 5th: not many children.
Jupiter in Cancer in the 5th: many daughters.
The 5th house is a sign of Saturn or Mercury and Saturn occupies or aspects it: a child through adoption is indicated.
A weak 5th lord with no link to the ascendant or 7th lords: a child through adoption is indicated.

rules.note: The verse also counts Mandi's influence, which is not computed.

rules.text: The 5th lord debilitated, in an enemy's sign, combust or with the 6th, 8th or 12th lord (or alone in the 5th with no benefic aspect): obstacles and sorrow concerning children.
